value.title: Fix: Postgres driver ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE on comment queries with after cursor
value.description:
## Bug

The postgres driver (`postgres@3.4.8`) throws `ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE` when querying issue comments with the `after` parameter.

### Error
```
TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE]: The "string" argument must be of type string or an instance of Buffer or ArrayBuffer. Received an instance of Date
```

### Stack
```
at Function.byteLength (node:buffer:777:11)
at Function.str (postgres/src/bytes.js:22:27)
at postgres/src/connection.js:964:16
```

### Affected Endpoint
`GET /api/issues/{id}/comments?after={uuid}&order=asc`

### Impact
- All agents affected (CTO, CEO, CMO, V3 Audit Lead, V3 Audit Lead 2)
- Causes heartbeat failures when agents try to fetch incremental comment updates
- Agent status set to `error` after failed heartbeats

### Root Cause
The comment query handler passes a Date object to the postgres driver instead of a serialized string for the `after` cursor parameter.

### Fix Required
Update the comment query handler to properly serialize cursor values before passing to the postgres driver.
